kicker: where an ai agent must stop

cover.title: 5 places an AI agent has to stop and wait for you.

items.title: Money
items.text: Buying a plan, paying a bill, moving funds. The agent prepares the page. You press pay.

items.title: Keys
items.text: Tokens, passwords, API keys. They never travel through the chat. You put them where they live.

items.title: People's data
items.text: Storing or sending personal data of others. The agent asks first, every time.

items.title: Publishing
items.text: Anything that leaves the repository: a post, a deploy, an email. One line, two buttons, your call.

items.title: Production settings
items.text: The switches that change the live machine. The agent writes the change. You flip it.
